scope: First numerical execution of the new wind A/B experiment, before its first passing result
observedFailure: Controller state does not match bounded interface/hash
cause: The original graph's hash-bound zero controller state was passed unchanged into the different B graph. The existing controller correctly rejected it.
fix: A retains its full original controller state; B constructs its own validated zero state. The study explicitly requires all numerical initial controller slots, last output and last step to be zero/null. Physical snapshots stay identical.
evidenceType: Development note derived from the actual exception; not a raw execution log or a passing test
